label: prf:categorical-instanton-unique
title: Proof of uniqueness of categorical instantons up to gauge
html:
Proof. Proof of uniqueness of categorical instantons up to gauge

The proof strategy uses characteristic classes and gauge equivalence. We demonstrate that the second Chern class c_2 completely classifies the solutions up to gauge transformations. Consequently, any two instantons with the same c_2 coincide, and the moduli space of solutions is faithfully parameterized by H^4.

Two self-dual connections with the same c_2 differ by an element of \ker(d_{\nabla_1}) acting on the fibre — i.e. by an automorphism of A preserving the Frobenius--Hopf structure. Such automorphisms form the categorical gauge group \mathrm{Aut}^\otimes(\tau). Thus \nabla_2 - \nabla_1 \in \Omega^1(\mathrm{Ad}(A)) is a horizontal form on which the self-duality constraint acts by definition (both connections are self-dual), so it integrates to a gauge transformation g realising \nabla_2 = g \cdot \nabla_1 \cdot g^{-1} + g\,dg^{-1}. The moduli \mathcal{M}^{\mathrm{inst}}_k is the quotient of the self-dual connection space by this gauge action.
